model.name: FeatureManager.revokeFeature impl
model.description: BUILT (R31.8 slice-b): FeatureManager.revokeFeature(featureUuid, token, profiles, saveProfiles) — removes token from Feature.allowedUsers[] (disk) AND featureUuid from profile.features[], mirror BOTH sides atomically. Owner-gated at the caller (POST /api/feature-manager action=revoke, requireOwnerHttp→assertOwner, INV-F4 root-of-trust). The data-driven gate (requireFeatureAccess) then denies the revoked user by membership immediately (revoke-immediate: featureAllowedUsers reads fresh from disk). Marker [impl:uuid:987a31a9-...] on the revokeFeature decl. Live effect: revoke flips a live non-owner 200→403 by membership (INV-F6).
